changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Converge planning, dimension, model and metric navigation on the unified modeling workbench. Existing menu ids and portal_menu_visibility bindings remain intact for rollback and observation.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE portal_menu SET deleted = TRUE, last_modified_by = 'sprint79-menu-convergence', last_modified_date = now() WHERE name IN ( 'sys.nav.portal.warehousePlans', 'sys.nav.portal.studioSemanticObjects', 'sys.nav.portal.studioSemanticModels', 'sys.nav.portal.studioMetricWorkbench', 'sys.nav.portal.dataMetrics' ) AND deleted = FALSE;
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE portal_menu SET deleted = FALSE, last_modified_by = 'system', last_modified_date = now() WHERE name IN ( 'sys.nav.portal.warehousePlans', 'sys.nav.portal.studioSemanticObjects', 'sys.nav.portal.studioSemanticModels', 'sys.nav.portal.studioMetricWorkbench', 'sys.nav.portal.dataMetrics' ) AND deleted = TRUE AND last_modified_by = 'sprint79-menu-convergence';
